description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and similarity for four different language pairs. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The first line, representing "en&en", is red and solid; it begins at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a peak of 0.26 at layer 6, then declines to 0.11 at layer 16, and finally increases sharply to 0.42 at layer 22. The second line, representing "en&es", is light blue and solid; it starts at approximately 0.08 at layer 0, increases to 0.13 at layer 6, remains relatively stable around 0.10 between layers 8 and 16, and then rises to 0.18 at layer 22. The third line, representing "en&el", is green and solid; it begins at approximately 0.06 at layer 0, increases to 0.12 at layer 6, declines to 0.08 at layer 12, and remains around 0.06 between layers 16 and 22. The fourth line, representing "en&bn", is pink and solid; it starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, increases to 0.10 at layer 6, declines to 0.06 at layer 12, and rises to 0.10 at layer 22.
